procedure: One question per ingested paper, generated from its abstract with the prompt in generate_questions.py; papers ordered by arXiv ID. The source paper_id is the retrieval ground-truth label.

questions.title: Attention Is All You Need
questions.question: How can neural networks process sequential data without using recurrent or convolutional layers?

questions.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
questions.question: How can deep neural network language models be improved by training them to understand context from both directions simultaneously?

questions.title: Attention is not Explanation
questions.question: Do learned attention weights in neural networks reliably indicate which input features are most important for making predictions?

questions.title: Analyzing Multi-Head Self-Attention: Specialized Heads Do the Heavy Lifting, the Rest Can Be Pruned
questions.question: How important are different attention components in transformer models and can some be removed without significantly impacting performance?

questions.title: Visualizing and Measuring the Geometry of BERT
questions.question: How can the geometric structure of contextualized word representations in transformer-based language models be analyzed and quantified?

questions.title: What Does BERT Look At? An Analysis of BERT's Attention
questions.question: How does the self-attention mechanism in transformer-based language models focus on different types of linguistic information during processing?

questions.title: Attention is not not Explanation
questions.question: Can attention mechanisms in neural networks be used to reliably explain model predictions and interpretability?

questions.title: Adaptively Sparse Transformers
questions.question: How can attention mechanisms in neural networks be made more efficient by dynamically adjusting which positions to focus on?

questions.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
questions.question: How does the performance of transformer-based language models change as model size and training data increase?

questions.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
questions.question: How can neural networks be used to retrieve relevant text passages for answering questions when the answer could be anywhere in a large collection of documents?

questions.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
questions.question: How can neural language models be enhanced by incorporating external information sources to improve performance on tasks that require factual knowledge?

questions.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
questions.question: How do large neural language models perform on downstream tasks when given only a small number of training examples?

questions.title: Transformer Interpretability Beyond Attention Visualization

questions.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
questions.question: How can I efficiently fine-tune large language models without updating all parameters?

questions.title: Improving language models by retrieving from trillions of tokens
questions.question: How can accessing massive amounts of external text data during inference improve the performance of neural language models?

questions.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
questions.question: How can we improve the ability of large language models to perform multi-step reasoning tasks by modifying the prompting strategy?

questions.title: Locating and Editing Factual Associations in GPT
questions.question: How can we identify and modify the internal representations of facts stored in large language models?

questions.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
questions.question: How can neural networks for natural language generation be trained to better align with human preferences and intentions?

questions.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
questions.question: How should model size and training data be scaled together to achieve the best performance for a fixed computational budget?

questions.title: Atlas: Few-shot Learning with Retrieval Augmented Language Models
questions.question: How can language models be improved for tasks with limited training examples by incorporating external knowledge?

questions.title: In-context Learning and Induction Heads
questions.question: How do transformer models use previous examples provided in the prompt to improve their predictions on new tasks?

questions.title: Interpretability in the Wild: a Circuit for Indirect Object Identification in GPT-2 small
questions.question: How can we mechanistically understand how language models determine which entity receives an action in a sentence?

questions.title: Stabilizing Transformer Training by Preventing Attention Entropy Collapse
questions.question: What causes instability during the training process of large language models that use self-attention mechanisms?

questions.title: Pythia: A Suite for Analyzing Large Language Models Across Training and Scaling
questions.question: What tools or resources are available for studying how neural language models behave during the training process and at different model sizes?

questions.title: Towards Automated Circuit Discovery for Mechanistic Interpretability
questions.question: How can we automatically identify the internal components and pathways in neural networks that are responsible for specific behaviors or capabilities?

questions.title: Sparse Autoencoders Find Highly Interpretable Features in Language Models
questions.question: How can we extract meaningful and understandable representations from the internal activations of large language models?

questions.title: From Entropy to Epiplexity: Rethinking Information for Computationally Bounded Intelligence
questions.question: How should we reconsider traditional information-theoretic measures when dealing with agents that have limited computational resources?

questions.title: Symmetry in language statistics shapes the geometry of model representations
questions.question: How do statistical patterns in linguistic data influence the spatial organization of neural network embeddings?
